missionUnderstanding.question: For each of the (94-claimed / 97-actual) slated (county, rail) pairs: does the OLD serve path still exist in code, and is it still reachable by a live caller? Three-way verdict per pair: legacy absent / present-unreachable / present-reachable. Read-only -- retires nothing.
missionUnderstanding.keyMechanism: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/parcelRecordAllowlist.ts's resolveAllowlist() is fail-closed: 'record' only when BOTH slate-membership AND a passing gate verdict; everything else ('legacy' or 'refused') falls through to whatever the pair's *ServeCutover.ts wrapper does on 'not record'.
missionUnderstanding.granularity: 13 *ServeCutover.ts modules cover the 18 rails (6 dollar/structural rails share one module, cadRollServeCutover.ts). None of the wrapper code branches by county except through the allowlist's own slate/verdict lookup (a DATA question), so a rail's present/absent/reachable verdict is uniform across every county slated for that rail -- the per-pair audit collapses to a per-rail audit for the 'does code exist / is it wired in' half of the question.
